summary: Trojanized tailwindcss-forms typosquat with obfuscated remote-code loader in main entry
details: The npm package tailwind-contact-forms impersonates the legitimate @tailwindcss/forms plugin: package.json sets author to "@tailwindcss" and repository to tailwindlabs/tailwindcss-forms, and README/source are copied from the upstream plugin. The package main src/index.js begins with eval(atob("...")) over a ~50KB base64 blob prepended to the authentic plugin code. The decoded payload is obfuscator.io-style (string-array rotation via _0x5c1d/_0x5d8466 hiding node builtin names, hostnames, HTTP methods, and header names) and imports node:http, node:https, node:zlib, node:url and node:child_process. On require() it fetches remote content and spawns node with [eval] and injected globals (global.r=require, global.m=module) to run second-stage code. Observed network targets include ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com, hosts under drpc.org, and the Blockscout API, with endpoint paths such as /0x/cls and /0x/ls consistent with Ethereum wallet/transaction harvesting. The loader executes on any require('tailwind-contact-forms') or use as a Tailwind plugin per the copied README.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
